faq_extra.q: Are there any hidden state or local income taxes in Texas?
faq_extra.a: No Texas city or county levies a local income tax. Texas instead relies more heavily on sales tax and property tax to fund state and local government.

faq_bonus.q: How much are bonuses taxed in TX?
faq_bonus.a: Texas has no state income tax, so a bonus paid in Texas only has the flat 22% federal supplemental tax withheld (37% above $1,000,000/year) plus 6.2% Social Security and 1.45% Medicare. Total withholding on a Texas bonus is about 29.65%.

faq_bonus.q: What is the Texas bonus tax rate for 2026?
faq_bonus.a: 22% federal + 7.65% FICA, and $0 state tax. A $5,000 Texas bonus has about $1,100 federal and $383 FICA withheld, leaving roughly $3,517.

faq_bonus.q: Do I get any Texas bonus tax back?

faq_hourly.q: What is $20 an hour after taxes in Texas?

faq_hourly.q: Are there local income taxes in Texas?
faq_hourly.a: No. No Texas city or county levies an income tax on wages, so the hourly calculator applies federal tax and FICA only.

faq_se.q: How much is self-employment tax in Texas?

faq_se.q: Do 1099 workers in Texas pay quarterly taxes?

faq_hourly.q: Does Minnesota have any local income tax on wages?
